Assets.NotesMarkdown:
- Fix keyboard and mouse events being dropped while Windows switches the input layout.
- Widen the Settings window so long labels fit on a single line.
- Show a subtle glow around focused controls in the Terminal Dark theme instead of a focus outline.
- Shrink the Settings header to its intended height and align the toggle labels.
Assets.NotesHTML:
• Fix keyboard and mouse events being dropped while Windows switches the input layout.
  • Widen the Settings window so long labels fit on a single line.
  • Show a subtle glow around focused controls in the Terminal Dark theme instead of a focus outline.
  • Shrink the Settings header to its intended height and align the toggle labels.
